fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CRB CODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ 060002)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING
fields.description: Notices sent out to individual customers or others

fields.name: DAY, MONTH & YEAR CATEGORY OF NOTICES ISSUED
fields.description: Category of instutition. E.g. Comercial Banks, Microfinance Banks, DBFB Banks, Regulated Saccos, Unregulated Saccos, etc. Mandatory for 'Non-Individuals, otherwise left blank.

fields.name: CATEGORY OF INSTITUTION
fields.description: The code of the institution making credit report requests, otherwise left blank for individuals. Mandatory for 'Non-Individuals, otherwise left blank.

fields.name: INSTITUTIONS CODE
fields.description: The total number of notices sent out to customers for revised records after investigations.

fields.name: NUMBER OF NOTICES TO CUSTOMERS ON REVISED RECORDS AFTER INVESTIGATIONS
fields.description: The total number of notices provided to institutions on disputed customer information.
fields.payload_key:
NUMBER OF NOTICES TO CUSTOMERS ON REVISED RECORDS
AFTER INVESTIGATIONS

fields.name: NUMBER OF NOTICES TO INSTITUTIONS ON DISPUTED CUSTOMER INFORMATION
fields.description: Notices sent out to individual customers or others
fields.payload_key:
NUMBER OF NOTICES TO INSTITUTIONS ON DISPUTED
CUSTOMER INFORMATION
